Title: Sleep Apnea Isn't Just About Weight: 3 Habits That Narrow Your Airway

Description:
Obstructive sleep apnea happens when your airway narrows or collapses during sleep - and it's not just an overweight person's issue, since nearly a quarter of people with it have a normal body weight. Sleeping on your back, using a pillow that's too high, and taking sedatives or muscle relaxants can all make that narrowing worse. Try side sleeping and a lower pillow, and see a sleep clinic if the symptoms keep coming back.
